parameters.content:
## Independent open-source starter

This workflow is a neutral demonstration for a fictional cybersecurity technology company. It is not sponsored, endorsed, or maintained by Meltwater.

Demo Mode is the default. API Mode is optional and requires a legitimate Meltwater account, current endpoint documentation, and environment variables.

The workflow stops at a human-review packet. It does not email, publish, post, or contact journalists.

## Deterministic first

Normalize and calculate metrics before any LLM handoff. The prompt requires evidence IDs and marks absent fields unavailable.

Demo Mode uses a local fictional dataset. The optional LLM step is a handoff prompt; connect a model only after reviewing the deterministic metrics.

## API configuration

Set MELTWATER_API_BASE_URL to the endpoint supplied in your Meltwater contract documentation. Set MELTWATER_API_TOKEN and MELTWATER_SAVED_SEARCH_ID as environment variables or use the supported n8n credential mechanism. Never commit secrets.

Endpoint names and response shapes can vary by Meltwater product and access tier; validate against the current official documentation before enabling API Mode.
